current_tranche.materialization_note: Consolidated across five parallel P23 turnout tranches (a, c-v2, d, e, f; PRs #136-140), merged sequentially into main. Tranche A's unique contribution (no duplication found on any sibling tranche): Malindi (016), Garsen (018), Lamu East (021), Mwatate (025), Lagdera (029), Dadaab (030), Ijara (032), Wajir North (033), Eldas (037), Mandera West (039), Banissa (040), Mandera North (041), Mandera South (042), Marakwet East (147), plus Kipkelion East (188), Bureti (191), Sigowet/Soin (193) and Malava (201) which were cross-validated identically against tranche D/C/E respectively before this branch's copy was dropped in favor of the already-merged sibling. Tranche A additionally audited its full 50-constituency queue against tranches C/D/E/F and found 36 of 50 were independently re-derived elsewhere: 35 agreed exactly (including the per-candidate breakdown) and were resolved by keeping the already-merged sibling's file and dropping tranche A's redundant copy; one (Molo, 166) disagreed on rejected_ballots (220 on tranche A vs 720 on tranche F) — both read from the same source PDF, whose page 2 prints upside-down, a plausible source of a single-digit misread. Tranche F's independently-arrived-at value of 720 was kept as the resolution (matches the version already merged via PR #139); tranche A's 220 was dropped. Six constituencies reviewed in the tranche-A session were withheld rather than forced through, spanning three distinct reasons: (a) the established prison/special-polling-station denominator-gap pattern -- Sotik (194, 17-voter gap matching Sotik Prison) and Bomet East (196, 21-voter gap matching Bomet Prison); (b) a newly observed genuine arithmetic mismatch on the source form itself, where the four candidate cells do not sum to the printed Total Valid Votes even though every individual digit is clearly legible -- Kipkelion West (189, candidate cells sum to 41,907 against a printed Total Valid Votes of 41,807, a 100-vote gap) and Bomet Central (197, candidate cells sum to 57,670 against a printed Total Valid Votes of 57,565, a 105-vote gap coincidentally equal to the fourth candidate's own count), both left unresolved per the extraction contract's invariant that arithmetic-mismatch rows remain promotion-blocked even when their component integers are individually source-verified (matching the Fafi precedent from an earlier tranche); (c) a registered-voters denominator gap (Ainamoi, 190, printed 85,246 vs governed 85,024, a 222-voter gap only partially explained by two identified special stations -- Kericho Main 46 + Kericho Annex 13 = 59 -- leaving 163 voters unaccounted for) and a severely internally inconsistent source document (Likuyani, 200, whose official upload prints a literal spreadsheet '#REF!' error in its own aggregate-results box, has candidate cells summing 584 short of the printed Total Valid Votes, and shows two different registered-voter totals -- 72,449 at the top of the form vs a 71,778 polling-station-level county total -- within the same document). All six are left unresolved rather than forced through or explained away with an assumption not evidenced on the source. Tranche B (merged earlier via PR #135's lineage) separately contributed Marakwet West, Keiyo South, Tinderet, Aldai, Nandi Hills, Chesumei and Mosop, and flagged its own denominator conflict on two adjacent constituencies (Keiyo North 149, Emgwen 155) that overlaps with tranche A's independent finding of the same two rows -- both sessions agree these remain unresolved.

canonical_rebuild_sync.note: The canonical full-build output was synchronized after deterministic rebuild drift was detected. This audit metadata does not authorize any additional geography or value promotion.

invariants: No county, ward, media, citizen-tally or candidate-party value is inherited or substituted.
OCR consensus is never sufficient for promotion without a separate source-image verification record.
Registered voters must reconcile exactly to the existing governed P23 constituency voter denominator.
Total valid votes plus rejected ballots must not exceed registered voters.
Turnout must be derived only from the three verified source integers and remain in [0,100].
An unresolved or unreadable constituency remains in the 290-row audit and creates no canonical series or observation.
Adding further verified evidence files may only reduce existing P23 turnout slots; it may not create new governed slots.
Arithmetic-mismatch rows remain promotion-blocked even when their component integers are source-verified.

scale_plan.next_step: Continue independent official Form 34B source review or governed closure for the remaining P23 turnout rows; preserve all arithmetic conflicts, incomplete rows and ambiguous TOTAL labels without inference.
scale_plan.batch_rule: Source review may proceed in parallel, but canonical promotion remains a single deterministic reducer over independently source-verified rows.
scale_plan.phase_complete_when: All 290 constituency turnout slots are source-backed verified observations or have an independently approved governed evidence closure under the P23 extraction contract.
